description: Re-render one finished clip dubbed into one or more of 19 languages (en, es, fr, it, pt, hi, ja, zh, de, ko, nl, pl, ru, tr, id, vi, th, uk, ar). Creator feature (requires an active subscription); does NOT use your monthly video quota. Each call starts a new render (not idempotent). Returns a rerender_id; poll katto_get_rerender for the result.

languages.description: Target languages for the dub, as ISO 639-1 codes. Nineteen are available; the clip keeps its original audio for any language not listed here.

name: katto_dub_clip
